string-array.item: Subtitle lines on the seek bar, subtitles from a link and added audio tracks.
Lyrics in the music player and saved effect presets.
More player bar buttons, and Clone in Customize Player.
Keyboard Shortcuts, Increase text contrast and an always visible player bar.
Shortcut feedback, a default subtitle delay and subtitle size in pixels.
The welcome asks for your subtitle languages; a cast device can be hidden.
Ignored file extensions and Repeat in Settings.
Fixed: Live TV errors in your language; Bookmarks and Lyrics in the TV music player.
